auth.verifier: canonical 32-byte HMAC-SHA-256 base64url using an external pepper
auth.mode_boundary: explicit validated mode; omitted mode defaults to production and invalid modes reject; synthetic records authenticate only in synthetic mode
auth.rotation: overlap records with distinct globally unique ids, then revoke the old id

cors.origins: unique canonical HTTPS origins; allowed origins receive ACAO and Vary on all known-route outcomes; disallowed origins receive no ACAO

request_policy.bodies: forbidden; invalid framing gets generic 400 and connection close
request_policy.options: 204 only for exact known query-free routes
request_policy.unsupported_methods: exact known query-free routes return 405 with Allow: GET, HEAD, OPTIONS; unknown or query-bearing routes return 404

artifacts.descriptor: derived from release.json plus artifacts.json and pinned at startup
artifacts.verification: component identities, O_NOFOLLOW, fstat, size and SHA-256 on every request
